title: Causal Inference Notebook Lab
description:
Notebook-first causal inference lab separating reusable Python estimators from analysis notebooks. Covers propensity-score adjustment, inverse probability weighting, AIPW, matching, double machine learning, difference-in-differences, instrumental variables, regression discontinuity, synthetic control, heterogeneous treatment effects, bootstrap uncertainty, sensitivity analysis, and policy targeting.

Each notebook states the causal question, treatment/outcome/covariates and unit of analysis, the estimand, identification assumptions, effect estimates, diagnostics, uncertainty, and limitations. Synthetic datasets with known ground truth support reproducible development, and a benchmark Lalonde/NSW replication is included.
